# nemau_volume_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a volume to an instance.

Destroying it detaches the volume without deleting it: the volume belongs to `nemau_volume`.

Keep `instance_id` pointing at the `nemau_instance` resource: the platform refuses to delete an instance that still has a volume attached, and that reference makes Terraform destroy the attachment before the instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Referencing the instance makes Terraform detach the volume before it
# destroys the instance.
resource "nemau_volume_attachment" "data" {
  volume_id   = nemau_volume.data.id
  instance_id = nemau_instance.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Id of the instance. Reference `nemau_instance.<name>.id` so the volume is detached before the instance is destroyed.
- `volume_id` (String) Id of the volume to attach.

### Read-Only

- `device_id` (String) Stable device name inside the guest (`/dev/disk/by-id/<device_id>`), as reported by the attach task.
- `id` (String) Synthetic id `<volume_id>:<instance_id>`.
